You put your hand against the sheer face and see a way upward that no roadmaker would dare name.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
One natural climb within reach; each attempt covers up to your Speed in squares.
Duration
Movement resolves immediately.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand; any carried rope is supplied separately.
Limits
The companion ends in a separate safe square or remains carried outside combat; in combat choose legal separate endpoints before moving. Carrying requires a body and load the DA judges physically supportable.
Type
Skill / Utility

Climb a natural surface too sheer for an ordinary unaided ascent if the DA confirms that small seams, projections or cracks exist. No purchase of an earlier climbing card is required. A featureless wall, a ceiling or an impossible load remains impassable. Choose a reachable resting place within the rolled distance; if none exists, keep your initial secure position.

Weak
Climb up to 2 squares, capped by Speed, and keep a secure grip.
Standard
Climb up to 4 squares, capped by Speed, with one willing or unconscious companion carried with you.
Strong
Climb up to your Speed, with that companion; you may secure a held rope at a suitable anchor on arrival.
